StudioFillBackground: Fill empty areas with a background color
GetReadyShowHologram: Show the picture over the game, where it will be painted
StudioLinkPlaceholder: Paste a link to a picture
StudioTextClearBackgroundNote: A clear background leaves that part of the sign unpainted.
StudioLinkNote: A link straight to a PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP picture.
SettingsStatusBoxDescription: A small box at the top of the game with how far painting has come, so the app does not have to be in view.
SettingsVerboseDescription: Also record debug-level detail. Turn this on when diagnosing a problem.
StudioQualitySizeNote: Brush size in game units. Small is fine and very slow, large is quick and blocky.
SettingsKeyCaptureHelp: Click the key, then press the one you want. Letters, numbers, function keys, Space and Esc work.
SettingsAutoUpdateDescription: Downloads and applies a new version without asking, then restarts the app. Needs the startup check.
StudioCanvasHint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, double click to reset
SettingsHologramDescription: Draws the picture where it will be painted, on the get-ready page, so the position can be checked.
HomeDescription: Drop an image, paste a link or type some text, and paint it onto signs, frames and banners, or carve it into a pumpkin.
SettingsStopKeyDescription: Ends the painting for good. What is already painted stays on the canvas.
StudioColorsNote: Fewer colors paint faster, every color is one more change in the game.
SettingsPaintingSubtitle: How painting starts out. You can still change the speed and the picture on the get-ready page.
SettingsStrengthDescription: How solid the picture over the game is.
StudioNoPicture: Load a picture to see it on this canvas
SettingsDiagnosticsSubtitle: Log files help when something goes wrong.
SettingsCheckOnStartupDescription: Looks for a newer release on GitHub each time the app opens.
GetReadyNudgeNote: Moves the picture shown over the game, and the painting with it. Only needed if it sits a few pixels off the edge of the canvas.
StudioQualityNeonNote: Neon signs have four fixed brushes. A fine brush draws thin lines on a fine grid and takes longer, a heavy one is quick and bold.
SettingsLogFolderDescription: Opens the folder containing the daily log files.
SettingsLibraryFolderDescription: Opens the folder where each project keeps its picture and settings.
StudioPictureNote: PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP. You can also paste with Ctrl+V.
HomeTagline: Pick a source, pick a surface, let RustyPainter do the painting.
SettingsResetPaintingDescription: Puts the speed, the picture, the progress box and the painting keys back as they were at the start.
SettingsLibrarySubtitle: Saved projects are kept as ordinary folders, so they are easy to back up or move to another computer.
LibraryEmptyBody: Set up a picture in Studio and press Save. It comes back here with everything as you left it.
SettingsHologram: Show the picture over the game
GetReadySpeedNote: Slower is more reliable. If the game misses clicks or letters, lower the speed.
SettingsSpeedDescription: Slower is more reliable. Lower it if the game misses clicks or letters.
StudioTextureEstimated: The size of this surface's texture is estimated until it has been measured in the game.
SettingsKeysSubtitle: These keys only work while Rust is the window in front. Every other program keeps its keys.
SettingsSubtitle: Updates, painting, the Library and diagnostics.
StudioSaveTooltip: Save this setup to the Library
DownloadOnlyHttp: Only http and https links can be used.
DownloadTimeout: The website took too long to answer.
DownloadTooBig: The picture is bigger than {0} MB.
DownloadUnreachable: The link could not be reached. Check the address and your connection.
EngineColorModeFailed: The game did not switch color mode. Switch it by hand and try again.
EngineInputFailed: Painting stopped because sending input to the game failed.
EngineUnknownStep: The painter does not know the step {0}.

GetReadySetup: Open the paint screen of the {0} in Rust.
GetReadySetupScroll: Open the paint screen of the {0} in Rust. Scrolling out {1} times is done for you.
HotkeyProblem: {0} could not be set up. You can still start, pause and stop with the buttons.
InputKeyNotTypable: The key {0} cannot be typed with this keyboard layout.
InputNotAccepted: Windows did not accept the input. The game may be running as administrator; start this app as administrator too.
LibraryCouldNotOpen: That project could not be opened. It may be damaged or removed.
PaintCouldNotPrepare: The painting could not be prepared for this game resolution.
PaintHintFinished: The picture is on the canvas. Save it in the game.
PaintHintPaused: Switch to Rust and press {0} to carry on, or {1} to stop.
PaintHintRunning: Press {0} to pause or {1} to stop. Moving the mouse also pauses.
PaintHintStopped: What was painted so far is still on the canvas.
PaintLineFinished: Save the picture in the game.
PaintRustNotRunning: Rust is not running, so there is nothing to paint on.
RustNotFoundFull: Rust is not running, or its window cannot be found. Start the game first.
SettingsAppearanceSubtitle: The look of the app and the language it speaks.
SettingsKeyNotUsable: That key cannot be used. Pick a letter, a number, a function key or one of the common keys such as Space or Esc.
SettingsLanguageDescription: The language of the whole app. It changes at once.
SettingsThemeDescription: Light, dark, or the same as Windows.
StudioErrCouldNotOpen: {0} could not be opened. It may be damaged or not really an image.
StudioErrGif: GIF pictures are not supported. Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP link.
StudioErrLinkNotPicture: That link does not lead to a PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP picture.
StudioErrLinkOpen: The picture at that link could not be opened.
StudioErrNotALink: That does not look like a web link. It should start with http:// or https://.
StudioErrNotSupported: {0} is not supported. Use PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP.
StudioErrNothingToLoad: There was no picture to load. Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP file.
StudioErrPrepare: The picture could not be prepared.
StudioErrProjectGone: That project could not be opened. It may have been removed.
StudioErrProjectOpen: That project could not be opened.
StudioErrSave: The project could not be saved.
StudioErrSurfaceUnknown: The surface of that project is not known any more, so it was put on the one that was selected.
StudioErrText: The text could not be turned into a picture.

StudioScrollHint_few: Needs {0} scroll-outs in the game first.
StudioScrollHint_many: Needs {0} scroll-outs in the game first.
StudioScrollHint_other: Needs {0} scroll-outs in the game first.
UpdateFailed: Update failed: {0} Your installed version was not changed.
StudioFramesNote: Each frame has its own picture. A new frame starts as a copy of the open one.
StudioFramesSpeedNote: Slow shows a frame every 2 seconds, medium every second and fast twice a second.
EngineFrameFailed: Frame {0} of the sign would not open. Open it by hand and try again.
GetReadyFrameSpeed: Speed of the frames over the game
AboutInformationSubtitle: The details worth quoting in a bug report.
AboutLinksSubtitle: Ask a question, report a problem, read the code or support the project.
AboutNoChangelog: The changelog could not be read.
ImageFailed: The image could not be loaded.
StudioCarvingNote: The grays are how deep the pumpkin is cut. White cuts all the way through and lets the candle shine, black leaves the shell as it is. The picture is turned to black and white.
